editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a dusty old building with a crazy guy who has a knife and a phone. That is exactly what happens to three girls who find themselves in a deadly game. The bad guy, Evilio, has a twisted plan where their lives depend on whether their families pick up the phone. It is a high-stress setup that makes you feel the panic of the characters. The whole vibe is gritty and dark, focusing on the fear of being forgotten or ignored by the people you love most while a killer stands right over you.

You will notice that the tension stays high throughout the movie, and the acting makes the fear feel real. While some parts might feel a bit slow, the shocks are worth it. If you love old-school slashers, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick if you want something that keeps you on the edge of your seat without being too complicated.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the tension peaks as the last phone call is made. One girl manages to trick Evilio and break free from her bonds during a moment of distraction. She fights back with everything she has, leading to a messy struggle. Eventually, she kills the maniac using his own weapon. The movie wraps up with the survivors escaping the building, shaken and scarred, while the police arrive to find the bodies of the others.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and twisted games.
